env.ours: x3d.threejs reader (shared with the Babylon bridge) + three.js body, bundle sha fa1672fe84a6

gaps: the gradient is taken one voxel either side of the sample in the red channel, so a volume with no empty margin has no gradient at its border and draws nothing (as in X_ITE)
only the headlight and up to three more lights act; their attenuation, radius and spot cone are not applied (X_ITE applies them)
shadows and phaseFunction are kept and not used (X_ITE does not use them either)
anisotropic dimensions tilt X_ITE's normals differently from the bridge's (the bridge divides the gradient by the dimensions); the test uses a cube
